candidate.answerReason: The center is 4 units from the x-axis and 3 units from the y-axis. With radius 4, the circle is tangent to the x-axis and intersects the y-axis at two points.

methods.label: Find distances to the axes
methods.explanation: The distance from the center to the \(x\)-axis is \(4=r\), so they are tangent. The distance to the \(y\)-axis is \(3<4\), so they intersect.
methods.levelReason: Coordinate distances to the axes are Grade 7 knowledge, followed by the Grade 9 line-circle criterion.
